title: Absolute continuity of Bernoulli convolutions outside reciprocal Pisot parameters
exact_target: Must a random signed geometric series have a probability density whenever the reciprocal of its contraction parameter is not a Pisot number?

sources.citation: Baker, Koivusalo, Troscheit and Zhang, On the Fourier transform of random Bernoulli convolutions, JLMS 113 (2026), e70515.
